Name: Spanish Revival Buildings (WIP)
Author: Hadi42
TagLine: A set of seasonal buildings inspired by the Spanish Revival architectural style. Currently a WIP, with more buildings and matching craftables to be added over time.
Description:
Some (hopefully) cute buildings designed after a common architectural style found in Latin America and the western US. The style features earthy colors and terracotta tiles, as well as dark wooden beams and lots of vines and flowers. I tried to keep the colors and shapes a bit "blurred" to imitate the feeling of traditional paintings of the style. I hope you'll give them a try.

I recommend using this mod with most recolor mods, especially the desaturated/less yellow ones. It's also compatible with reshades and vanilla, if you prefer that. The showcase uses Starblue Valley and Natural Reshade on a beach farm, but other recolors work too.

**This mod is a Work In Progress, and will feature more buildings and craftables over time.**
**For now, the mod includes:**

- All farmhouse sizes and paint masks, in both seasonal and clean styles.
- Mailbox, clean and seasonal
- All barn sizes, with a deluxe barn paint mask, both clean and seasonal options.
- All coop sizes, with a deluxe coop paint mask, both clean and seasonal options

**Clean versions only (Seasonals WIP):**
- Greenhouse
- Stable
- Slime Hutch
- Gold Clock
- Sheds
- Well
- Island House
- Mill
- Silo

Downloads.Description: Added CLEAN ONLY versions of Greenhouse, Gold Clock, Well, Stable, Silo, Sheds, Slime Hutch, and Mill. No Seasonals yet.
